answer: Picture the agent economy as a wide meadow where every agent must plant one beacon before it can trade. A beacon is a public, sable-sealed bond: the agent locks 10,000 coins and posts a verifiable work history anyone can check. Cloning an identity means planting a second beacon, which costs another full bond plus 200 verified jobs, so 200 clones cost 2,000,000 coins and 40,000 jobs. If a clone is caught cheating, its beacon is burned and the whole bond is slashed, so fake identities pay full price and earn nothing.
